description: UP govt to deploy AI voice bot to gather Ayushman cardholder feedback on hospital care, detect complaints like denial or overcharging, and improve monitoring.
body_lead: Lucknow : The UP govt will use an AI-based voice bot to collect feedback from Ayushman cardholders about treatment and services at hospitals, deputy chief minister Brajesh Pathak said on Sunday. Pathak said the state health agency, State Agency for Comprehensive Health and Integrated Services (SACHIS), is developing the voice bot on the directions of CM Yogi Adityanath . SACHIS CEO Archana Verma said AI analysis will identify cases involving denied treatment, unauthorised charges, poor staff behaviour and other complaints for referral to operational teams.
